items.title: Model-Informed Gold Revisions Inflate Measured Accuracy: A Versioned Gold-Standard Protocol for LLM Extraction of ESG Data
items.claim: Model-prompted revisions to ESG gold labels raised measured accuracy 5.1 points with predictions unchanged, so benchmarks should version references.

items.title: Market Impact Estimation via Causal Foundation Models
items.claim: On a synthetic confounded prior, a causal foundation model tracks the unbiased impact oracle, but transfer requires encoding metaorders as added flow.
